root_cause_text: The `System.out.println("Hello")` statement on line 3 is missing a terminating semicolon (`;`).
beginner_text: In Java, complete instructions (called statements) must end with a semicolon `;`, much like sentences in English end with a period. Adding a semicolon to the end of the `System.out.println("Hello")` line tells the compiler that the statement is finished.
